beats.headline: Three skydiver's boxes
beats.text: After the Wasteland falls, Carl, Donut and Katia each open the same Silver Skydiver's box, and all three hold the same thing: three potions of Half Splat. Mordecai grunts. Keep them in the hotlist until you can get a real Featherfall, he says, but they are not that great: falling will not kill you, and you will be at five percent health when you hit the ground. Still better than that Dolores Doesn't Splat potion, Carl grumbles. Hey now, says Mordecai. That one is genius. Unpleasant, maybe, but Carl's health was at a hundred percent when he landed.

beats.headline: Off the top wing
beats.text: The biplane is spiralling down like water down a drain, and Quan Ch is closing in with his hands glowing. Carl chooses to worship Emberus, starts to glow, and tells Donut to get on his back, hold on with her claws if she has to, and take the half-splat potion. From the top wing he throws the celestial grenade at Quan and leaps. The god appears, and the plane flies into his nose and explodes. When they slam into the ground, Carl, invulnerable for sixty seconds, takes no damage. Donut bounces off his back and lies unconscious at five percent health, her skin smouldering and her hair singed.

beats.headline: Into the lacuna fog
beats.text: Phase two is over and the five gods have wandered off, so Carl and Donut set out across the lacuna for bubble 543. Getting out of their bubble is the hard part. Donut clings to Carl while he walks his feet down its almost invisible underside like Spider-Man, and at the lip both of them drink a half-splat and drop into the dark fog. The ground down there is completely flat.

beats.headline: The last one, in midair
beats.text: Sierra tosses Carl straight up into the sky like a rag doll, and he drops face-first toward her as she writhes on the treetops with her head on fire. He slams down his last half-splat potion. It will keep him from dying, though it will drop his health to five percent, but the boss is not on the ground, and he has no idea whether the potion even works like this. His gauntlet forms, he tears straight through her like paper, and he keeps falling through the branches. His ribs crunch and his legs break in the mud. He hits Heal.

beats.headline: A counter full of potions
beats.text: In the boudoir off the ballroom, a glorified locker room where nobody actually changes, Carl covers the bathroom counter with dinosaur repellent and half-splat potions, with a note for everyone who finds them: store the half-splat in the inventory in a ready position, and drink the dinosaur one now if they have not already. They may have to flee fast, and there will be loose, prey-driven dinosaurs everywhere. Carl wants them attacking the hunters, not the crawlers.
